Melee and ranged damage

The formulas below describe this engine's current rules. Item and spell examples are calculated from your loaded game data.

Weapon damage

Minimum damage = prototype minimum × material damage multiplier. Maximum damage = (prototype minimum + prototype damage range) × material damage multiplier. A strike rolls between those bounds, applies damage effects, and has a minimum raw damage of 1.

Each damage type receives its share of the strike. Natural armor and the equipment layers covering the struck body part then absorb that type separately.

Chance to hit

Roll = max(0, Attack + 2 × k − (B + 1)), where k is a uniformly chosen integer from 0 to B. A hit succeeds when max(0, Roll − aimed-strike penalty) ≥ Defense. B comes from the attacker's random-hit tuning.

Bows and crossbows have zero defensive weapon rating. Ranged projectiles retain the damage rolled when fired. Backstabs use the configured base multiplier plus the backstab perk divided by 100.
